content:
We prove by induction that \(a_n=n-2\) for all \(n\ge 4\).

Base: \(a_4=2=4-2\).

Inductive step: assume \(a_{n-1}=n-3\) for some \(n\ge5\). Then
\[
a_n=\left\lfloor \sqrt{n(n-3)}\right\rfloor.
\]
Since
\[
(n-2)^2 \le n(n-3) < (n-1)^2
\]
for \(n\ge5\), we get
\[
a_n = n-2.
\]
Thus the formula holds for all \(n\ge4\). Therefore
\[
a_{2017}=2017-2=2015.
\]

\boxed{2015}
